baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word-4 past predicator governs word-8 imperfect laughter, while the believers are introduced as the marked object after min.
baseline_models.mechanism: An offending group repeatedly opens its pleasure to view by making trusting assent into an object of derision. The temporal construction turns a laugh into a settled social practice, not an isolated reaction.

Temporal occurrence makes the laughter a recurring past condition rather than a single burst.
Trusting assent supplies the quality singled out and socially exposed as the target.
The mockery-object branch makes the laughter relational: its pleasure is produced at another group's expense.

changed_reading.after: The clause depicts recurrent public derision whose pleasure depends on turning the believers' trusting assent into its object.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 3 can activate acquisition or causing another to incur, and the durative word-4 construction carries that motion into the visible laughter at word 8.
baseline_models.mechanism: The subjects do not merely possess a prior criminal identity and then laugh. Their repeated laughter is itself a way of acquiring and inducing offense, with the opened face functioning as the act's visible yield.

changed_reading.after: Their habitual laughter is one mode of acquiring and imposing offense, visibly yielding the identity named at the clause's start.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cutting branch at word 3, social security at word 7, and the clear-road branch at word 8 can be composed around the from-construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Laughter works as a public boundary marker: it cuts believers away from social safety and makes the offenders' preferred path and rank unmistakable. The target relation is therefore spatial and institutional as well as affective.

changed_reading.before: Laughter expresses contempt toward a disliked group.
changed_reading.after: Laughter publicly maps rank, cutting the believers away from ordinary social security and declaring that exclusion to be the obvious path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening asymmetry of taking full measure while diminishing others migrates from goods to reputation. Mocking laughter becomes a nonnumeric scale that inflates the in-group by making the believers socially smaller.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition gives the ridicule an extractive gain for its performers.

changed_reading.after: Their laughter is social short-measuring: it manufactures surplus status for themselves by publicly discounting the believers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two groups are each placed within writing-and-marking sequences. Because focus laughter repeatedly opens the face to view, the supposedly fleeting gesture can be read as self-inscription: the offenders visibly enter themselves into the class their act discloses.

structural_cues: The matching book-and-mark couplets at 83:7-9 and 83:18-20 classify both groups before 83:29 names one group's habitual visible act.

changed_reading.before: Laughter vanishes as soon as the social encounter ends.
changed_reading.after: Each repeated laugh is a visible self-entry into the offenders' record: the act marks its performer while trying to mark its target.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier recurring earning construction and its no-exit inward result form a feedback loop with the focus's recurring laughter. Ridicule is both an outward overflow of what has accumulated in the heart and another acquisition that thickens the barrier.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel habitual constructions, inward entrapment, acquisition, and blocked access; I infer a loop in which laughter both reveals and reinforces the acquired condition. context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene joins good condition, radiant faces, pure drink, secure sealing, mixture, spring, and drinking. Focus laughter carries branches of gleam, visible overflow, and white sweetness, activating the offenders' laughter as counterfeit beatitude: a bright surface and overflowing pleasure that parasitizes the believers rather than receiving true abundance.

changed_reading.before: The offenders display ordinary mocking pleasure.
changed_reading.after: Their laughter stages a counterfeit radiance and abundance: an outward gleam and overflow fed by another group's humiliation rather than by genuine good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following sequence expands laughter into a reproducible group protocol: passing encounter, covert mutual signaling, return to the home group, entertaining recirculation, renewed sight, public speech, and a verdict of deviation. Laughter is the gateway signal that converts perception into shared classification.

Passing and crossing supply the encounter that initiates the routine.
Return and destination carry the encounter back into the offenders' own social setting.

Speech spreading among people converts a gesture into a circulating group claim.

structural_cues: The branchless mutual-signaling root at 83:30 is retained only as a sequence cue between passing and returning.
The repeated encounter clauses in 83:30-32 move from gesture to home-group amusement to an explicit group judgment.

A live alternative treats them as cumulative examples of contempt rather than one reproducible protocol.

changed_reading.before: A crowd repeatedly laughs when believers are present.
changed_reading.after: Laughter initiates a distributed reputational protocol that carries a sighting through covert cues and in-group entertainment into a public verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the mockers label the believers, the denial that they were commissioned as guardians exposes the role their laughter has been performing. Ridicule is pseudo-oversight: it assumes a rank from which they watch, sort, and discipline people without authorization.

activation_trace.role: Place and rank supply the elevated social position the mockers implicitly claim.
An apparently clear path lets their laughter masquerade as an obvious judgment about who is rightly guided.

structural_cues: The negated commission in 83:33 immediately follows the mockers' explicit judgment in 83:32 and retains the same over-them relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a denied guardian commission immediately after labeling; I infer that laughter participates in an enacted claim to jurisdiction. A live alternative limits the denial to their spoken verdict and treats laughter as affectively related but institutionally inert.

changed_reading.before: The offenders ridicule peers from a horizontal social position.
changed_reading.after: Their laughter performs unauthorized guardianship, using ridicule to impersonate the authority to inspect, classify, and correct the believers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later clause preserves belief, the from-relation, and laughter while exchanging actor and object and replacing habitual past with the bounded present day. Laughter is therefore not an owned trait of one class but a reversible relational operator whose direction exposes the status of the underlying order.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies returning recompense, produced action, and the repeated habitual frame; I infer that the focus laugh belongs inside the action that cycles back. A live alternative leaves laughter as evidence of the conduct while locating recompense in a wider, unspecified set of deeds.

changed_reading.before: A later audience answers the offenders' earlier laughter with an opposite laugh.
changed_reading.after: The earlier laugh is a generated return-bearing act: what its performers acquired through ridicule comes back as their own recompense.

strongest_changes: The parallel habitual constructions at 83:14 and 83:29 turn laughter into both the overflow and further acquisition of a self-sealing condition.
The 83:30-33 sequence expands laughter into a circulating classification protocol and then denies the mockers the guardian authority that protocol impersonates.
The exact actor-object exchange at 83:34 makes laughter a reversible relation rather than a permanent possession of the dominant group.
The returning-recompense branch at 83:36 completes the focus acquisition model by sending the produced act back to its maker.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventory allowed laughter to coexist as mockery, facial opening, visible overflow, gleam, clear path, and botanical opening, while the offense root simultaneously carried guilt, acquisition, cutting, harvest residue, and bodily resonance. Context activated several mechanisms without forcing them into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The move from commercial short-measure to reputational grading is structurally strong but reader-supplied.
Counterfeit radiance depends on adjacency and cross-domain branch overlap, so it should coexist with the simpler contrast reading.
The body-witness and false-harvest models are anchored but deliberately imagistic; neither should be promoted to a direct lexical gloss.
